integrity: A complete self-contained proof of the new deletion and decoupling assertions is provided, together with exact finite checks and explicit credit for prior marginal laws. No independent validation or historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed short-chord lengths and fixed numbers of marks only; no joint finite-sample rate is asserted. The normal approximation for crossing counts is cited from prior work. An early source on crossing/component limit laws could not be inspected in full, leaving priority uncertainty.
title: Gaussian–Poisson decoupling for local chords and global crossings
